notes: Rotation-accuracy program, wand-weaving addition (2026-09-28): Shoot (5019) is declared inert because this build's item table has no wand with required_level <= 10, so the ladder's level-10 rung equips nothing in the ranged slot and core.RegisterShootSpell never registers the spell there; from level 20 on it resolves and fires heavily (up to 77 percent of top casts) on this bare, no-consumes, no-buffs ladder character. Vanilla Frost at 60 is Frostbolt spam: with no Fire talents, working a Fire Blast cast into the rotation spends a global that Frostbolt would otherwise fill, for less damage -- the engine lane's spec tasks measured a 2.0 percent (FullBuffs) to 5.6 percent (NoBuffs) DPS loss versus Frostbolt alone, so Fire Blast is left out of the default rotation. Cold Snap and Ice Lance are the spec's own utility and are handled by Frost-specific logic, not this priority list. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/ (the one its manifest.json records last).

priorityList.notes: Shoot (5019, core.RegisterShootSpell) is the wand-weaving fallback added by the rotation-accuracy program's caster-wand finding (2026-09-28): sim/mage never enabled a ranged auto attack or registered a Shoot action, so a leveling Frost mage's equipped wand dealt zero damage even though the ladder harness always equips one. Gated below 20 percent mana so it only fills globals Frostbolt could no longer afford; the engine multiplies its damage by the Wand Specialization talent's 13/25 percent bonus when taken.
